edges.reason: msg.sender is the account credited when staking LP tokens.
msg.sender is the account debited when withdrawing LP tokens.
msg.sender determines which rewards mapping entry is paid out.
updateReward checks account != address(0) against the untrusted caller.
Reward accrual is bounded by block.timestamp (min with periodFinish).
rewardRate derives from block.timestamp, making the rate miner-influenceable.
checkStart gates staking on block.timestamp >= starttime.
notifyRewardAmount branches and sets schedule fields based on block.timestamp.
stake invokes the external LP token transferFrom with the staked amount.
withdraw invokes the external LP token transfer to the caller.
getReward invokes the external reward token transfer to the caller.
getReward reads the scaling factor from the external YUAN token contract.
getReward reads and zeroes rewards[msg.sender].
updateReward modifier runs before stake body.
updateReward modifier runs before withdraw body.
updateReward modifier runs before getReward body.
checkStart modifier gates stake execution.
checkStart modifier gates withdraw execution.
checkStart modifier gates getReward execution.
updateReward stores rewardPerToken() into rewardPerTokenStored.
updateReward stores lastTimeRewardApplicable() into lastUpdateTime.
updateReward writes the rewardPerTokenStored checkpoint.
updateReward writes the lastUpdateTime checkpoint.
updateReward calls earned(account) to settle the account reward.
updateReward writes userRewardPerTokenPaid[account].
exit calls withdraw(balanceOf(msg.sender)).
exit calls getReward after withdrawing.
rewardPerToken uses getrewardPerTokenAmount() for the elapsed accrual.
rewardPerToken divides by totalSupply().
rewardPerToken adds the stored accumulator.
earned subtracts userRewardPerTokenPaid[account].
earned adds the previously stored rewards[account].
earned calls rewardPerToken().
getrewardPerTokenAmount queries getFixedRewardRate for interval endpoints.
getrewardPerTokenAmount uses distributionTime for interval math.
getrewardPerTokenAmount uses lastUpdateTime as the accrual start.
getrewardPerTokenAmount uses halveInterval for interval splitting.
getFixedRewardRate clamps the timestamp with periodFinish.
getFixedRewardRate subtracts distributionTime.
getFixedRewardRate shifts initialRewardRate to derive the current rate.
getFixedRewardRate divides by halveInterval to count elapsed intervals.
rewardRate forwards block.timestamp to getFixedRewardRate.
notifyRewardAmount compares block.timestamp with starttime to pick a branch.
notifyRewardAmount requires block.timestamp >= periodFinish and sets it.
notifyRewardAmount writes initialRewardRate from _firstReward.
notifyRewardAmount writes lastUpdateTime.
notifyRewardAmount writes distributionTime.
notifyRewardAmount uses DURATION to compute the distribution window and _firstReward.
updateReward(address(0)) modifier runs before notifyRewardAmount body.
Malicious LP token could re-enter stake during safeTransferFrom.
Malicious LP token could re-enter withdraw during safeTransfer.
Malicious reward token could re-enter getReward during safeTransfer.
onlyOwner setter writes the rewardDistribution address.
onlyRewardDistribution gates notifyRewardAmount on the rewardDistribution address.
stake transfers through the uni_lp token instance.
withdraw transfers through the uni_lp token instance.
getReward transfers through the yuan token instance.
getReward calls yuansScalingFactor on the yuan token instance.
stake amount parameter drives the staking update.
stake amount is passed into uni_lp.safeTransferFrom.
withdraw amount parameter drives the balance update.
withdraw amount is passed into uni_lp.safeTransfer.
earned uses the account parameter to look up balances and checkpoints.
notifyRewardAmount uses the reward parameter to compute the rates.
getFixedRewardRate uses _timestamp to compute the halving shift.
scalingFactor scales the amount transferred by yuan.safeTransfer.
trueReward is the amount transferred by yuan.safeTransfer.
_firstReward is divided by halveInterval to set initialRewardRate.
_rewardPerTokenAmount accumulates the interval contributions in getrewardPerTokenAmount.
_currentRewardRate is used for the last partial interval contribution.
_lastUpdateTimeOffset positions lastUpdateTime within its halve interval.
_firstIntervalEnd bounds the first partial halve interval.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to drive the stake accounting and transfer, so it is absorbed into the stake function node.
The amount parameter only exists to drive the withdraw accounting and transfer, so it is absorbed into the withdraw function node.
The account parameter is only meaningful inside the earned view, so it merges into the earned function node.
The reward parameter is only used to derive the rate schedule inside notifyRewardAmount, so it merges into that function node.
The _timestamp parameter is the sole input of the rate computation and merges into getFixedRewardRate.
scalingFactor is consumed directly to compute the amount moved by the reward token transfer.
trueReward is exactly the value transferred by yuan.safeTransfer, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
_firstReward is a temporary used only to set initialRewardRate inside notifyRewardAmount.
The accumulator is local to the accrual computation and merges into its function node.
The current rate local is only used inside the accrual loop and merges into its function node.
The offset local is only used to bound the first partial interval inside the accrual function.
The interval end local is a temporary boundary used only inside the accrual function.
